scope: No universal L1 or Linfinity translation modulus tending to zero exists for the output densities over the full target class; this already fails for A=I_3 and iid compact finite-fragment indicator marginals supported in [1,10], although every constructed output density is individually bounded and continuous.
summary: For arbitrarily large s choose a unit-measure finite union E_s inside {x in [1,10]: dist(sx^2,2piZ)<=pi/3}. Then |E exp(isX^2)|>=1/2. For Q_s=sum_{j=1}^3 X_j^2, |phi_s(s)|>=1/8. With shift a_s=pi/s, Fourier duality gives ||p_s(.-a_s)-p_s||_1>=1/4; support length <=298 gives Linfinity translation difference >=1/1192, while a_s->0. This refutes only a uniform equicontinuity/Arzela compactness interface, not the bounded-density conjecture or individual continuity.
